data.one_liner: Consent Management Platform framework for legal compliance.
data.what_it_does: The Usercentrics Apps SDK is a Consent Management Platform solution for mobile apps, games, and TV applications. It enables the collection, documentation, and management of your user's privacy choices to ensure legal compliance around the world.
use_when: You need to collect and manage user privacy consent for legal compliance in your app
You are using Usercentrics as your Consent Management Platform
avoid_when: You do not need to manage user consent or privacy compliance
You prefer an alternative consent management provider
strengths: Ensures legal compliance for different legal frameworks
Supports cross-platform environments like Android and iOS
Includes features like Braze consent mediation and TCF support
weaknesses: Requires an external Usercentrics account and paid plan for full usage
Requires specific minimum platform target versions (e.g., iOS 11)
data.setup_notes: Requires setting minimum Android/iOS versions, configuring Kotlin version, and optionally multidex depending on configuration.
